description.en_US: Context Editing Middleware that automatically prunes tool results to manage context size. This middleware mirrors Anthropic's context editing capabilities by clearing older tool results once the conversation grows beyond a configurable token threshold. The implementation is intentionally model-agnostic so it can be used with any AI model.
description.zh_Hans: 提供上下文编辑中间件，自动修剪工具结果以管理上下文大小。该中间件通过在对话超过可配置的令牌阈值时清除较旧的工具结果，模拟了Anthropic的上下文编辑功能。该实现故意与模型无关，因此可以与任何AI模型一起使用。
